title: Melancholy Martin

nodes.title: Short roll
nodes.body: The same cut and tap, with less room between them. If it splits into two notes, that is the remark.

nodes.title: Melancholy Martin
nodes.body: The slip jig, slowed. The short roll only where it is marked. Where two of the same note sit together, a cut or a tap can separate them.

source: Traditional slip jig. Francis O’Neill, O’Neill’s Music of Ireland (1903), no. 1154. Setting written for this pack. Short roll on a long note first.
